settings.hero_desc: A striking architectural model of a G+2 commercial building with warm LED-lit windows, landscaped plaza, roads and a branded base. The perfect centrepiece for a developer's sales suite or boardroom.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your building, lighting, landscaping and branded base
settings.s1_body: We recreate your commercial or office building as a detailed scale model and bring it to life with warm LED lighting glowing through the windows. Set on a base with plaza, roads and landscaping, it's the ideal piece for a sales suite, investor pitch or reception - built faithfully from your drawings, down to the facade and entrance.
settings.case_body: Built for Style Consultancy to verify their client's architectural design. After delivery, they found a couple of design flaws which were easily fixed, saving them millions in design mistakes before construction.
settings.case_quote: The lighting makes it spectacular. It anchors our office building and impressed our client.
settings.prov_p: A model honours the design; lighting brings it to life. Together they turn a development into a showpiece that helps to visualize the project before construction.
